features.feature_value: Deferential to free-speech unless the post promotes violence/illegal activity

features.feature_value: Rejecting primarily when there is name calling or lots of foul language

features.feature_value: Allow strong opinions but reject when it becomes hate/dehumanizing toward groups

features.evidence_span: i got rid of anything that used profanity
